subject: Override part of a theme_text value

messages.author: fbcfedba2abc5340
messages.subject: Override part of a theme_text value
parts:
Hi all,

I want to edit certain parts of a theme_text element, without
overriding the other defaults. I want to do

theme <- theme_get()

and then say

theme$axis.text.x$size = 14

Leaving the other defaults as they were. How can I do this though? I tried

theme$axis.text.x = theme_text(size=14)

but that just overwrites the whole thing instead updating only the
size part. Thoughts?

-Chris Neff

messages.author: 4fdc04b06b76c8cf
messages.subject: Re: Override part of a theme_text value
parts:
Hi,

have you tried to set the changes you want with the
opts parameter?
E.g
plot + opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size = 10))

You can find some examples here:
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/Axis-Attributes


/johannes
